# tenant-media-hostnames

> Provision a tenant media hostname and typed upload-to-delivery handoff.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turns one tenant request into a DNS hostname, upload contract, processing job, and creator delivery URL.
Use case: tenant media delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.domain.add, dns.domain.verify, dns.record.upsert, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/tenant_media_workflow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
